0x0009D4.en: 「With what I've got now...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x000ACD.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x000CF7.en: 「Ugh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000D32.en: 「Like hell I'll screw up here...!@ This isn't fun...」

0x000D86.en: 「That did it...!@ No choice but to fall back...」

0x000ED7.en: 「So this is it... The rest is up to you.」

0x000F09.en: 「Dammit...!@　Is this as far as I go!?」

0x000F83.en: 「No good, we took too much... Retreating!」

0x000FD0.en: 「Well, this is a fix. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x00100E.en: 「Eeek! The rest is in your hands!」

0x001055.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x001100.en: 「Ngh... To think I'd end up a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0012A9.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0012F0.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x001325.en: 「Damn! Is this the limit of my power...!?」

0x001411.en: 「To be beaten in a place like this...@　I'm still so green...!」

0x00145F.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x00151A.en: 「Sorry, I leave the rest to you!」

0x001549.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001587.en: 「Good grief, so this is the end.」

0x0015B6.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x001641.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0017A7.en: 「Ejecting...@　Ngh...! Can't even do it gracefully...」

0x001865.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001A35.en: 「A-all hands!@　Abandoning ship is top priority...!!」

0x001AA9.en: 「Guess I've no choice but to fall back...!」

0x001B06.en: 「Still, Hugo...@　I never thought you'd bite back at your old man@　like that back there.」

0x001B81.en: 「I've got no intention of dying like a dog@　just doing what Mitarl says. And neither does the captain...」

0x001C40.en: 「You both fought well.@　We made it out of that death trap@　thanks to your backup.」

0x001D07.en: 「It's fine.@　I knew you two had doubts about@　the Zentr Project.」

0x001D9A.en: 「And, Warrant Officer Foglia...@　Your commitment as a team member@　is what led to this result.」

0x001E21.en: 「Don't forget what you learned in today's battle.」

0x001EA9.en: （Foglia... Captain Albero...@　Where is the captain now, and what is he...?）

0x001F05.en: 「...Hugo, it's almost time for the@　patrol mission briefing.」

0x001F7A.en: 「My men investigated the Tomine Lab,@　but found no physical evidence that could@　pinpoint Dr. Tomine's whereabouts.」

0x002019.en: 「As for where you were sending the data...@　after many relay points, it turned out to be a@　British firm called the Horsham Company.」

0x00212A.en: 「I figured as much.@　I had my men check it, but it's a dummy company.@　We're still tracing what lies beyond it.」

0x0021B5.en: 「Let me confirm again. Are you fine with@　continuing to accompany the Steel Dragon Squadron?」

0x002226.en: 「Yes...@　If the Jinrai has been deployed in combat,@　targeting the DyGenGuard and Aussenseiter...」

0x0022C8.en: 「If I stay aboard this ship, I might have a chance to encounter it...@　And then I have to stop the Jinrai... stop my father...」

0x0023BC.en: 「Well... it's not really a big deal, but...@　some of the free members are having tea,@　so I thought I'd invite you.」

0x00248F.en: 「But you've been holed up in your room@　ever since you came aboard, right?@　A little change of pace might...」

0x00251F.en: 「...Because of me and my father,@　I'm causing everyone trouble.@　I'm in no mood for that...」

0x0025A6.en: 「You know...@　I know I'm not much to rely on, but...@　your feelings... I can share a little...」

0x002643.en: （Minaki...@　She won't open up so easily, huh...）

0x0026D6.en: 「And, modest though it is, I've prepared some sweets.@　Do enjoy.」

0x002748.en: 「Speaking of tea, where's our tea warrior?」

0x0027B3.en: 「Mmm~, Ratsel's sweets really@　are the absolute best~!」

0x00280F.en: 「Wh-what is this treat!?@　It's delicious, way too delicious!!」

0x002862.en: 「Trombe-brand sweets would send@　any run-of-the-mill pastry chef@　running for the hills.」

0x0028E6.en: 「Actually, Michiru...@　you like sweets with a face like that?」

0x00293F.en: 「My face's got nothing to do with it, idiot!」

0x00299B.en: 「Okay, okay, that's enough!@　You're not children, so don't fight@　over something so silly!」

0x002A1C.en: 「Despinis, Irui, could you@　hand out drinks to everyone?」

0x002A8B.en: 「Um, is that... going to be okay...?」

0x002AC8.en: 「It's fine, it's fine.@　Clifford would say 'just a bit more.'」

0x002B27.en: 「Then I'll take the tea...@　Irui, could you handle the coffee?」

0x002BD4.en: 「I... wanted to do something for everyone...」

0x002C5A.en: 「So I had her help brew the tea, too.」

0x002CE6.en: 「It's nothing.@　Kusuha and the others are protecting us, after all...」

0x002D36.en: 「Sanger, why don't you join everyone too?」

0x002D70.en: 「No, I just came to get some water...」

0x002DE2.en: 「That girl, going up to Major Sanger...」

0x002E2F.en: 「Even I was nervous when I first@　met him...」

0x002F32.en: 「...No, it's good.@　You've got quite a knack for it.」

0x002F8F.en: 「I'll take you up on it again. But make it black next time.」

0x003028.en: (Major Sanger... @　there's more to him than just being tough...)

0x00307B.en: 「Guess I'll have a cup too, then.」

0x003140.en: 「I thought it might help with the fatigue, @　so I put in a lot of condensed milk and sugar...」

0x0031B4.en: 「There's a limit to that kind of thing... @　Boss, I can't believe you drank it all.」

0x003210.en: (See, I told you. @　You can't just make it the usual way.)

0x003269.en: (Ugh... I thought I'd gone easy on it, too.)

0x0032AC.en: 「The Hiryu and Hagane have safely crossed the Tropic of Cancer @　and are heading for the waters off Mexico's east coast.」

0x003323.en: 「As for the course after that... as shown on the monitor, @　we head south, pass east of the Galapagos Islands, @　and make for Iti-Iti Island.」

0x0033D1.en: 「...So we're basically hugging the east coast @　of Central and South America.」

0x003442.en: 「We're avoiding the waters between Polynesia and South America @　to stay clear of the Gaia Sabers... is that it?」

0x0034D8.en: 「Correct. @　Their base, Grand Christmas, is located @　in the Marquesas Islands of Polynesia.」

0x003568.en: 「Besides, after the dimensional rift, didn't the Hiryu run into @ Air Christmas while passing through those waters?」

0x003607.en: 「This detour accounts for that, but... @ lately, the Ruina have shown up in Central America too, @ not just South America's east coast.」

0x0036D0.en: 「To deal with that, not just the Federation@　but the Gaia Sabers as well are likely operating@　along South America's east coast and its surrounding waters.」

0x003775.en: 「In other words, from here on the odds of running into @　the Ruina or the Gaia Sabers rise sharply.」

0x0037F8.en: 「So, to strengthen our patrols, we'll carry out this mission @　centered on units with superior detection @　and mobility.」

0x00388B.en: 「I've drawn up the rotation myself. @ Those of you here... Ryusei and Aya, @ Hugo and Josh make up the first team.」

0x00393C.en: 「Board immediately and carry out the mission. @　The patrol airspace data for each of you @　will be sent to your units. That's all. Dismissed.」

0x003A2E.en: 「Lieutenant Hugo, a word. You stay behind.」

0x003AC5.en: 「Somehow... I'm getting by on borrowed time.」

0x003AFC.en: 「Is your supply of the drug all right? @　That's something only Doctor Mitarl Zapad @　can formulate, isn't it?」

0x003BAB.en: 「Tell me the truth. When does the drug run out? @　How much longer can you keep fighting?」

0x003C4A.en: 「...So you had no room to spare after all.@　And your condition's worse than I thought.」

0x003CBE.en: 「So that's part of why you've had Aqua @　running TE Absorber simulation drills.」

0x003D5A.en: 「Hugo, the moment we reach Iti-Iti Island, @　I'm pulling you off duty.」

0x003DC6.en: 「You may be fine now, but what happens when the drug runs out? @　If something goes wrong, what becomes of Aqua, @　riding alongside you?」

0x003E5F.en: 「If not for this situation, I'd have you out of @　the TE Absorber this instant.」

0x003ED9.en: 「I understand how you feel about Mitarl Zapad. @　So I'll permit you to pilot the TE Absorber @　as long as the drug holds out, but...」

0x003F93.en: 「Rush things and you'll throw your life away for nothing. @ Even without you fighting, we can still expose @ and condemn the Zentr Project.」

0x004053.en: 「Whatever you do, don't think of going to Grand Christmas @　alone. That's the same as throwing your life away.」

0x0040D6.en: 「The Zentr Project, and the Gaia Sabers, are no longer @　your problem alone. They're a problem for all of us.」

0x00416B.en: 「For now, think about surviving. @　Do that, and a path will open. If Major Albero were here, @　I imagine he'd tell you the same thing.」

0x004279.en: 「And... once the patrol is over, @　I recommend you get examined by Radha.」

0x0042E4.en: 「She handles Lamia's maintenance too... @　she might just find a lead toward a solution.」

0x004373.en: 「Also, tell Aqua the truth. @　I understand not wanting to drag her into @　the business with Mitarl Zapad, but...」

0x00441B.en: 「She's your partner, sharing the same machine. @　Isn't she the very first person you should lean on...?」

0x0044AA.en: 「This is roughly the outline of our assigned airspace.」

0x004527.en: 「I hope we can just reach Iti-Iti Island @　without anything happening...」

0x00458C.en: 「Hey, Hugo. You've been silent this whole time since @　we launched... Did something happen @　in your talk with Major Kai?」

0x004616.en: 「...Never mind that, you take the controls. @　It's part of your training.」

0x004666.en: 「Sure, but... you're not feeling unwell @　or anything, are you?」

0x004759.en: 「All right, Josh. Let's stay around here a little...」

0x0047A2.en: 「Contact on radar! @　Twelve o'clock! High-speed flying objects, closing in!」

0x0047FB.en: 「To run into them in a place like this...」

0x00483C.en: 「Their carrier is likely nearby as well. @　Shall I call in Chienne and the others?」

0x004904.en: 「I'll find out just who's piloting that thing!」

0x004944.en: 「Gamma 1 to all units. @　I'll take on the Cerberus. @　You capture the Re-Tech machines.」

0x0049CB.en: 「Gamma 1 to all units. @　I'll take on the Garmraid. @　You capture the Re-Tech machines.」

0x004A80.en: 「Already did. @　The others are heading our way too.」

0x004AD6.en: 「Got it. @　Josh, don't push yourself until reinforcements arrive.」

0x004B3C.en: 「...I'd like to prove the superiority of AI1 @　and the Medius here. @　Do not hold back, whatever you do.」

0x004BC6.en: 「If you don't produce results, @　your child won't survive, after all.」

0x004C4D.en: 「Aqua, hand control back to me. @　I need you on engine output adjustment.」

0x004CC2.en: (Aqua... @　the data your machine predicts and you select @　will be known to my child as well.)

0x004D49.en: (To beat our Medius, @　you have to draw out a pattern @　AI1 can't predict.)

0x004DC7.en: (Can you do that, as you are now...?)

0x004E04.en: 「Medius Locus...! @　Today, I'll find out for certain who's inside you!」

0x004E78.en: 「Rasmunanium, CA control. @　Repairing damaged armor sections.」

0x004F4F.en: 「No need. I know his habits well. @　Move in!」

0x00500E.en: 「H-he read me...! @　And only one person can pull off that return move!」

0x005061.en: 「Hugo, you tend to break away to the right @　after attacking. @　Looks like you never fixed that habit.」

0x005147.en: 「Yeah, my former commander...! @　But why is the captain in a Medius!?」

0x0051AC.en: 「I was invited by the Gaia Sabers and chosen @　as the pilot of the Medius Locus. @　That's all there is to it.」

0x005248.en: 「Y-you knew I was the pilot @　of the Cerberus...!?」

0x0052A1.en: 「Y-you knew I was the pilot @　of the Garmraid...!?」

0x00536F.en: 「Impossible... why would the captain turn on me...!」

0x0053AC.en: 「You're fragile, Hugo. Have you forgotten what I taught you!」

0x00545F.en: 「Capture it. @　I've already shown the Medius's superiority.」

0x0054B5.en: 「But that last battle @　makes for poor training material for AI1.」

0x005527.en: 「You revealed your identity and shook Lieutenant Hugo. @　In other words, that result came from you, not AI1... @　and that renders it meaningless.」

0x0055F9.en: 「That machine is also a product of the Zentr Project. @　We can't very well destroy it.」

0x00566D.en: 「There's not enough data for AI1's growth. @　Have you forgotten Doctor Zapad's words?」

0x0056E4.en: 「Albero, did you deliberately end it quickly @　on purpose...」

0x005734.en: 「He was simply too green, nothing more. @　If you're unhappy with the process, you should have @　recruited a more capable test pilot.」

0x00586B.en: 「Gamma 1 to all units. @　It's settled on my end. You capture @　the Re-Tech machines.」

0x0058F0.en: 「Major, giving an order like that while we weren't around... @　that's cold of you.」

0x00596B.en: 「No kidding. Right when we finally get to go @　all-out against the Steel Dragons.」

0x0059D4.en: 「...Whoever the opponent is, the job's the same.」

0x005A0E.en: 「The Steel Dragons' main force is closing in. @　You hold them off.」

0x005B48.en: 「Major Kai, Lieutenant Hugo and the others are unconscious!」

0x005B91.en: 「Understood. @　Keep them safe until we get there.」

0x005C1F.en: 「Heheh, we finally get to meet them.」

0x005C5C.en: 「Long time no see, Bronze 27 and 28. @　Or should I say Seolla and Arado now.」

0x005CCA.en: 「You know who we are, don't you?」

0x005D47.en: 「Been a while since I heard that name.」

0x005D75.en: 「Well, we always stood out even in the School. @　Not that we ever cared to hang around with @　a cozy little group like you lot.」

0x005E25.en: 「Why are you two with the Gaia Sabers!?」

0x005E65.en: 「You disappeared when the School was disbanded...」

0x005EA2.en: 「What did Aguila tell you? @　That we were disposed of, or died in a ditch?」

0x005F07.en: 「When they decided to disband the School, @　we deserted.」

0x005F76.en: 「We meant to kill Adler and Aguila on the way out too, @　but all we managed was to wound the old man.」

0x00601E.en: 「...And that's why we couldn't get away cleanly.」

0x00607D.en: 「After that, a certain organization picked us up @　and we joined the Gaia Sabers.」

0x0060DF.en: 「We were the School's guinea pigs, and now @　we're the president's own unit. Quite the promotion, huh?」

0x006196.en: 「But you lot made a bit of a name for yourselves @　in the Inspector Incident, didn't you?」

0x00620C.en: 「Traded blows with that Aurun 1 again and again, and beat it? @　I was shocked when I heard.」

0x0062E5.en: 「But because you got involved, that woman @　ended up dead all the same, didn't she? Hm?」

0x00637E.en: 「They don't know a thing about how Latooni and the rest feel!」

0x0063C7.en: 「Latooni and Arado never wanted to fight @　your sister...!」

0x00643B.en: 「Heh, Bronze and Latooni-class washouts, @　now the Special Combat Instructor Squad...」

0x0064B9.en: 「Quite the promotion, but getting mixed up with @　the Steel Dragons was your undoing. In the end, you're all losers.」

0x006542.en: 「Die already, you washouts. @　For old times' sake in the School, @　we'll be the ones to see you off.」

0x0065C6.en: 「To think it would come to this, School graduates @　fighting each other...!」

0x00662B.en: 「You don't like it? @　You're soft, you lot. @　It doesn't matter to us who we're up against.」

0x0066A6.en: 「If it means becoming winners, @　we'll use anything as a stepping stone.」

0x006705.en: 「Do you two even understand what kind of @　organization the Gaia Sabers is!?」

0x00676D.en: 「Of course we do! @　The strong survive, and they get to call it justice!」

0x0067C3.en: 「And you're criminals and traitors. @　We don't need a reason to strangle you!」

0x006837.en: 「Same reckless brats as ever. @　Pick a fight with us, and you know it won't end @　with just a slap on the wrist, right?」

0x0068E5.en: 「Ha! This isn't La Gias, it's the surface! @　No matter what you say, the righteous cause @　is on our side!」

0x006981.en: 「That righteous cause of yours is exactly what's in doubt!」

0x0069B5.en: 「Then tell me, Seolla... what do you fight for?@　Justice? To keep the Earth at peace?」

0x006A2F.en: 「That's right...@　So no more kids like us, like Ouka,@　ever have to fight again...」

0x006AA4.en: 「Wrong!@　We're <Boosted Children>. We were built,@　trained, to cut our enemies down!」

0x006B2D.en: 「If we don't fight, we don't survive!@　And there's your proof. In the end,@　you're still a pilot too!」

0x006BC3.en: 「Fighting's the only way to live we were ever@　taught. That's all we are!」

0x006C25.en: 「If you hate it so much, climb out of that machine!@　I'll vaporize you in a heartbeat!」

0x006C93.en: 「...If you're gonna push it that far,@　then I can't just back down either...」

0x006D01.en: 「You're right. We don't know any other way@　to put food on the table.」

0x006D69.en: 「But right now, I'm fighting to protect@　what needs protecting!」

0x006DBF.en: 「Oh-ho, a stirring little battle cry!@　But way too cliche!」

0x006E24.en: 「...Everybody dies. Fight and survive,@　and you still die in the end.」

0x006E86.en: 「So why not live it up, have some fun,@　and go out laughing? Right!?」

0x006F22.en: 「What kind of <RemCon> did they run on you?@　It's amazing you've lasted this long like that.」

0x006F9B.en: 「Look who's talking!@　You're still dragging your RemCon around!」

0x006FF7.en: 「For the record, we were always like this.@　Made things easy on Aguila, I bet.」

0x00707B.en: 「We're not drugged to the eyeballs like you.@　So, Seolla... that makes us better than you.@　As <Boosted Children>.」

0x00713B.en: 「Besides, you were a <Neue DC> lackey, weren't you?@　You've got nerve lecturing us.@　One RemCon and allies turn into enemies, right?」

0x007218.en: 「Hey, you! That's enough out of you!」

0x00725E.en: 「The Seolla now isn't who she used to be!」

0x007292.en: 「Seolla, don't let her words get to you.@　She's trying to shake you.」

0x007316.en: 「Useless. I know exactly what Aguila@　put her through.」

0x007378.en: 「Rough stuff for a girl to go through, huh!?@　Want me to spell it out right here!?」

0x00741D.en: 「Chienne! Say one more word and you're dead!!」

0x007491.en: 「Hmph... the weakest dogs always bark loudest.」

0x0074FF.en: 「Dunno how big you think you are...@　but anybody who'll torch a whole town@　without blinking is nothing but trash.」

0x0075D5.en: 「Even I can tell who the real villains are.@　And you lot are just the dogs@　wagging your tails for 'em.」

0x007687.en: 「And dogs like you@　aren't gonna block our path!」

0x0076DD.en: 「Get off to the side and go piss on a lamppost!@　Chop-chop!」

0x0077E8.en: 「Yeah, took the wind right out of their sails.」

0x00781F.en: 「Michiru, was that all part of the plan...?」

0x007862.en: 「Thought she was all muscle, but the girl's@　got a quick tongue on her too.」

0x0078C4.en: 「Good at getting people worked up...@　Just like Lieutenant Katina.」

0x007917.en: 「Is that supposed to be a compliment?」

0x00795B.en: 「Anyway, no sense moping over the ravings@　of a bunch of snot-nosed brats.」

0x0079D5.en: 「Can't argue with that.@　Seolla, Arado, don't let it get to you!@　Knock some sense into those punks!」

0x007A65.en: 「Right...!@　There's still something I have to do!@　No way I'm dying as their stepping stone!」

0x007B04.en: 「Yes...@　For Ouka... for our classmates too,@　we have to live.」

0x007BBF.en: 「I'm one proof that they all existed...@　So I can't die yet.」

0x007C21.en: 「And I won't use my power for the wrong reasons.@　Even if it wasn't a power I ever wanted.」

0x007CAD.en: 「Told you already!@　What's right and what's wrong,@　the winner decides, the survivor decides!」

0x007D52.en: 「The heck's that supposed to mean?@　Feeding Arado that line,@　your own words are just as cliche.」

0x007E0A.en: 「...I chose a different road than you.」

0x007E47.en: 「Then I'll cut that road short right here!@　All units, engage!」

0x007EB9.en: 「No hesitation, Seolla.@　You chose this road. Surviving is the only thing that matters now.」

0x007F37.en: 「Even handed a suicide mission,@　lose the will to live and nothing gets done.」

0x008036.en: 「So it was you piloting the Medius all along!?」

0x0080B6.en: 「Captain of the Federation's special PT unit,@　the Cry Wolves... in other words,@　Ensign Hugo's former commanding officer.」

0x00813A.en: 「Sounds like 'it's complicated' doesn't@　begin to cover it.」

0x00818D.en: 「Yeah. This Zentr Project@　stinks worse by the minute.」

0x0081F5.en: 「Major Albero, why are you with Gaia Sabers...@ No, you knew, and still turned on Hugo!?」

0x008291.en: 「That's right. But you have no need to know why.@　Nor do Hugo Medio and Aqua Centrum.」

0x008326.en: （Pitting members of the same unit against each other...@　They could still coordinate, leak information.）

0x0083B5.en: （What's the point of gathering combat data@　at such a risk? And besides...）

0x00842F.en: 「Major Kai.@　Why would Major Albero go out of his way@　to hail us in a situation like this?」

0x0084DE.en: 「I know.@　...Major Albero, what do you intend to do with Hugo and the others?」

0x008540.en: 「Capture them. Along with the Re-Tech machines.」

0x008577.en: 「Those machines hold the key@　to Ruina's secrets, don't they?」

0x0085D0.en: 「Steel Dragon Squadron commander,@　Colonel Lefina Enfield.@　Disarm at once and surrender.」

0x008654.en: 「That offer is one I must decline.」

0x0086C0.en: 「Captain, getting pinned down here is dangerous.@ Not just Gaia Sabers reinforcements,@ the Federation could show up too.」

0x00875C.en: 「I know.@　This ship and the Hagane hold position and altitude on TD.@　Prepare for a crash dive.」

0x0087D1.en: 「Once we recover Ensign Hugo and the others,@　we pull out of the combat zone.」

0x008824.en: 「...Albero, you hailed them on purpose, didn't you?」

0x008870.en: 「They'd have learned it sooner or later.」

0x00889B.en: 「But you handed them extra information too.」

0x00892B.en: 「Joshua, you focus on getting clear!@ We'll recover Hugo and the others!」

0x008993.en: 「Lim, they're gunning for our machines!@ Watch yourself!」

0x008A0B.en: 「Adler's dead, Aguila's dead!@　Good riddance! You're next!」

0x008A6A.en: 「Once you're dead,@　our brand goes up in value!」

0x008AD0.en: 「Boosted Children!@　It's a real selling point in this line of work!」

0x008B38.en: 「You think the washout of the low-rank@　Bronzo Class can beat me!?」

0x008BA6.en: 「Plenty of people called me a washout@　and lost. More than you'd think!」

0x008C05.en: 「Not interested in old comrades.@　We were never comrades anyway.@　You're a pain, so just hurry up and die.」

0x008CB4.en: 「Fighting the kids from Argent Class...!@　But if I falter here...!」

0x008D38.en: 「You're brittle. I could tell from that little exchange.@　RemCon aftereffects?」

0x008DD4.en: 「Defective Boosted Children should just die!@　To raise our rank!」

0x008E5D.en: 「We both survived all the way to here...!」

0x008EA0.en: 「That's exactly why we fight!@　The winner's the real Boosted Child!」

0x008F11.en: 「I don't want a title like that!」

0x008F48.en: 「Not interested in the past.@　Why don't you just disappear already?」

0x008FA1.en: 「Are you doing this because you want to!?」

0x008FE4.en: 「Well, sticking with those two is the easiest gig.@　...Talking's a pain, so hurry up and die.」

0x009064.en: 「Latooni! Go make nice with your sister in the next world!」

0x0090A4.en: 「I have a reason to fight too... a reason I can't retreat.@　So I won't lose to you...!」

0x00911B.en: 「Killing Aurum One doesn't mean@　you can take us down!」

0x00917A.en: 「You have no right@　to speak of me and Ouka...!」

0x0091D3.en: 「There's three of us, two Bronzo...@　and just you in Latooni Class.」

0x009251.en: 「So you'd be better off dead, right?」

0x009288.en: 「...You can't erase the proof that I existed.」

0x0092D1.en: 「A muscle-brained idiot like you@　will never catch my Kerberion!」

0x00933C.en: 「Then I'll grab you by the collar@　and make you yelp like a good little dog!」

0x0093A4.en: 「Still skulking around over there!?@　The lamppost's that way!」

0x009406.en: 「You'll regret this in the next world!」

0x009477.en: 「Ngh!@　Say what you want, you're the losers here!!」

0x0094D0.en: 「Warped little brats like you,@　I'll beat some spirit back into you with the Kaiser's fist!」

0x00958A.en: 「Getting out-talked by Michiru,@　you're nothing special either!」

0x0095E6.en: 「A war doesn't get decided@　by a shouting match!」

0x009639.en: 「If words won't teach you, your body will!@　That you're no match for us!」

0x0096BC.en: 「I'm not dumb enough@　to let the likes of you finish me off!」

0x009718.en: 「Hand over that machine quietly and I'll spare your life.」

0x009758.en: 「Like I'd believe that...@　from the man who deceived Ensign Hugo!」

0x0097D3.en: 「Major, you knew the truth behind@ the Zentr Project! So why,@ why side with Gaia Sabers!?」

0x00988D.en: 「You have no need to know why!」

0x0098C4.en: 「A man like you, playing along with their farce!」

0x009907.en: （No... or does he have no choice!?）

0x00993E.en: 「You're all traitors now!@　You're in no position to lecture me!」

0x0099A3.en: 「Major Albero, to think I'd fight you...@　No, we already did, off the Izu coast!」

0x009B23.en: 「Hugo, snap out of it!@　That man means to destroy us!!」

0x009B82.en: 「It's a lie... the Captain would never...」

0x009BCF.en: 「Lost the will to fight, has he.」

0x009C19.en: 「Move, Hugo!@　At this rate we're finished!」

0x009CD1.en: 「Do you mean to die here!?@　Knowing nothing, doing nothing,@　is this where you want it to end!?」

0x009D64.en: 「I refuse. Dying with nothing to show for it!@　Dying without ever knowing the truth!」

0x009DCF.en: 「If you really can't do it, switch with me!@　I'll fight!」

0x009E44.en: 「I can do it!@　That's what the training was for!」

0x009EC2.en: 「Fighting in this thing is my job...!」

0x009EFC.en: 「If the Captain won't back down, I have to fight...@　To survive, I have to fight...!」

0x009F7F.en: （Hmph... so you've found your resolve, Hugo.）

0x009FB9.en: 「Perfect. Now we can gather more data.@　Continue the engagement with the Cerberus.@　I trust you won't refuse.」

0x00A05B.en: 「Perfect. Now we can gather more data.@　Continue the engagement with the Garmraid.@　I trust you won't refuse.」

0x00A119.en: 「And... keep me a secret from her for now.」

0x00A181.en: 「Aqua, can you push the output higher!?」

0x00A1E0.en: 「Here I come, Captain...!　You're going to tell me why!」

0x00A226.en: 「The Medius, the Captain joining Gaia Sabers,@ was it all Mitarl's doing!?」

0x00A2B0.en: 「Just keep dancing quietly@　in the palm of our hand!」

0x00A306.en: 「You know full well@　what kind of man Mitarl is, Captain!」

0x00A368.en: 「Tch, not bad! I'm pulling back for now!」

0x00A3B1.en: 「Guh! I'm not gonna be one of the losers!@　I'm falling back for now!」

0x00A416.en: 「...Dying in a place like this would be idiotic.@　I'm heading back.」

0x00A469.en: 「Hmph, better than I expected.@　We're pulling back, Erde.」

0x00A4BC.en: 「Why? The armor damage can be repaired.」

0x00A4FF.en: 「Our losses are too heavy. We're withdrawing here.」

0x00A5A4.en: 「Don't underestimate them. We'd get more than singed.」

0x00A5E7.en: 「Who cares!　We'll chase them down ourselves!」

0x00A62A.en: 「Defy me, and you're as guilty as they are.@　Don't forget who we answer to right now...」

0x00A735.en: 「Enemy units are withdrawing from the combat zone!」

0x00A7B7.en: 「All units, be advised. We're also pulling out of the zone.@　Deploy EP!　Splashdown, crash dive!」

0x00A85C.en: 「Ensign Hugo...@　Everyone here knows your circumstances.@　We'd like to hear your take.」

0x00A8E6.en: 「As Major Gilliam said before,@　during the Septempurm battle...」

0x00A93F.en: 「It seems Mitarl's aim wasn't a mock battle, but combat data@　on TE Absorbers fighting each other in a real engagement.」

0x00A9D8.en: 「True enough. Pit the Cry Wolves against each@ other, lives on the line, and you get good data -@ more so if there's bad blood.」

0x00AAA1.en: 「But that's not the case here, is it?」

0x00AAD5.en: 「...For me, at least.@　The bad blood I carry is toward Mitarl.」

0x00AB3A.en: 「The same should be true for Major Albero.@　And Dr. Zapad should know that as well.@　As for why the major turned his fangs on you...」

0x00AC0C.en: 「Most likely... like me, he has some reason@　he's forced to follow Mitarl.」

0x00ACBA.en: 「No...@　Back then, the captain was the one who saved me.@　If he were in the same bind as me, he'd never...」

0x00AD5F.en: 「Any other reason you can think of?」

0x00ADB5.en: 「As long as Major Albero is with the Gaia Sabers,@　it's only natural he'd stand against us, but...」

0x00AE3E.en: 「Choosing to reveal himself right then...@ maybe some guilt is eating at him...」

0x00AEB2.en: 「Ensign Hugo,@　can you keep fighting Major Albero after this?」

0x00AF11.en: 「...Yes.@　To learn why the captain follows Mitarl...@　and the full truth of the Zentr Project.」

0x00AFAD.en: 「That's... for the Cry Wolves...@　and for me, the one who survived, the final mission.」

0x00B049.en: 「But Hugo... don't forget what I told you.@　If you can't see it through before we reach Iti-iti Island,@　then leave the rest to us.」

0x00B0F7.en: （Why, Captain Albero...? Mitarl's scheme@　was the cause... it was because he danced us on strings@　that Foglia and the others died...）

0x00B19F.en: （The captain should hate that man even more than I do...@　so why...?）

0x00B207.en: （Can I find the answer...@　in what little time remains...?）

0x00B2C5.en: 「No...@　After all that happened, it's only natural...」

0x00B318.en: 「I don't know the details, but@　he was like family to you, wasn't he?」

0x00B37D.en: 「Yeah.@　Captain Albero taught me how to fight.@　And he saved my life, too...」

0x00B429.en: 「Even so,@　having the truth thrown in your face like that...@　it's more than a man can take...」

0x00B4E4.en: 「It's complicated.@　Resentment, a sense of duty... or maybe...」

0x00B53D.en: 「But whatever he feels, I can't move forward@　until I find the answer...@　That's how I see it.」

0x00B5F5.en: 「Re-Tech's sponsor was Alteur...@　And with the Gaia Sabers tangled up in that too,@　I can't just stay uninvolved.」

0x00B6B2.en: 「...You still won't tell me what you're carrying.」

0x00B701.en: 「It's fine, I won't force it out of you.@　And... sorry about earlier,@　talking out of turn like that.」

0x00B7A6.en: 「No... without you as my partner,@　I might already be dead.」

0x00B82D.en: 「Captain Albero once taught me:@　carry out the mission you're given and come back alive...@　strike down the enemy you must, and survive...」

0x00B924.en: 「To get my answer, I have to fight.@　And for that, I need your help.」

0x00B98F.en: 「You didn't have to say it. I'm with you.」

0x00B9C9.en: 「And my circumstances...@　once we reach Iti-iti Island, I'll tell you.」

0x00BA7B.en: 「There's something I want to confirm before we reach the island.@　Until then... just wait for me.」

0x00BAF6.en: 「Egretta, Carly, Albero,@　and those brats... the Gaia Sabers have a lot@　of people with history against us.」

0x00BB98.en: 「You think maybe that's the reason@　they picked their members?」

0x00BC28.en: 「We're their top-priority target.@　So settling things is up to...」

0x00BC9C.en: 「Don't take it all on yourself, Arado.@　Same goes for you, Seolla, Latooni.」

0x00BD45.en: 「Those guys picked fights with us back in La Gias too,@　and it still ticks me off.」

0x00BDA7.en: 「I can't forgive it either... the way they talked to Latooni@　and the others.」

0x00BE1B.en: 「Right.@　They don't know a thing about what the three of them@　went through fighting Ouka...」

0x00BE8D.en: 「But they won't hesitate. If you don't steel yourselves,@　you'll be the ones who die.@　Don't forget what Major Kai said.」

0x00BF42.en: （Once more... I have to face the past...@　so that we can move forward too...）

0x00C04B.en: 「Well, I can manage to move around now.」

0x00C0A7.en: 「The prototype Units 8 and 9 are shaping up.@　I figured it's about time I headed to Tochka 8.」

0x00C161.en: 「Mm. Assembly's finished, and it's entered@　the final adjustment phase...@　I'd like to see it finished by my own hand.」

0x00C1F4.en: 「There's no point without the Re-Tech machines.@　I'd say it merits a lower priority.」

0x00C277.en: 「So I should pour it into Unit 10... the MODEL-X instead?@　You've got enough budget, haven't you?」

0x00C2FA.en: 「It's you I'm talking about, Doctor.@　If you've time to fuss over the NV unit,@　I'd rather you keep aiding my project.」

0x00C3B1.en: 「It's not that simple.@　After the Ruina appeared, Alteur@　pressed me to finish it quickly.」

0x00C42F.en: 「Then before the Steel Dragon Squadron rebelled,@　we could have seized just the Re-Tech machines@　by presidential order... a shame we didn't.」

0x00C4D4.en: 「The Weapon Box Hanger works on its own,@　so it's no loss to build it.」

0x00C54B.en: 「Besides, I've a promise to keep with Felio.」

0x00C5AD.en: 「Well, in any case, I'm off to Tochka 8.@　I'd like to use some of the data@　from the Zentr Project. That all right?」

0x00C664.en: 「Give me the list first.@　I'll decide based on that.」

0x00C6B7.en: 「Understood.@　Then I'll look forward to seeing@　the MODEL-X finished.」

0x00C729.en: （Hmph... an NV unit, when there's no telling@　whether it'll even amount to anything...）

0x00C7AA.en: 「You're back. I hear you made contact@　with the Steel Dragon Squadron... and Ensign Hugo's group?」

0x00C80C.en: 「Yes.@　And Albero disclosed his hand.@　That he's piloting the Medius...」

0x00C8A3.en: 「Let me confirm once more...@　If it proves the Medius's superiority and lets AI1@　achieve further growth...」

0x00C954.en: 「Then it's fine to destroy the TE Absorbers@　belonging to Ensign Hugo's group, correct?」

0x00C9C8.en: 「Yes... his body should be reaching its limit soon.@　If he has no intention of returning here to prolong his life...」

0x00CA54.en: 「Then he can at least die as a foundation stone@　for the Zentr Project.」

0x00CADB.en: 「If it goes badly, Ensign Aqua will share Hugo's fate...@　You're all right with that?」

0x00CB86.en: 「Heh, you're a frightening woman.@ ...By the way, where's Major Albero?」

0x00CC07.en: （Foglia... to save you,@　I'll walk the demon's road...）

0x00CC57.en: （Forgive me, Hugo...@　this is the only path left to me now...）

0x00CCB6.en: （And I swear I will...@　This is the Cry Wolves' final mission.）
